headlines.title: Nearly 20 Million Eggs Recalled Due to Salmonella Risk
headlines.description: Nearly 20 million eggs have been recalled for potential salmonella contamination. The eggs were sold in six states under several different brand names from the company Midwest Poultry Services out of Texas. The eggs have a sell or best by date between July 20 and August 17.

headlines.title: Measles cases hit 35-year high in 2026
headlines.description: The Center for Disease Control is reporting a new 35-year high in the number of measles cases as new outbreaks pop up in multiple states. NBC News' Dr. Akshay Syal has more on what this means and how to protect yourself.

headlines.title: Questions grow over potential impact of budget cuts on response to cyclospora outbreak
headlines.description: As cyclospora cases rise nationwide, federal agencies investigating the outbreak are being put under the microscope. NBC News' Dr. Akshay Syal reports on the growing scrutiny over whether funding cuts have impacted the government's response.

headlines.title: Cyclospora outbreak from tainted lettuce served at Taco Bell expands
headlines.description: Investigators are now tying Cyclospora cases in Illinois, Kansas, Oklahoma, and Pennsylvania to Taylor Farms iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin explains what people need to do to stay safe.

headlines.title: Amazon has a bunch of Lego sets on sale for up to 44% off
headlines.description: Amazon is discounting Lego sets, with savings up to 44 percent off. Shop the best deals on Lego Star Wars, Creator, Botanicals and more before they sell out.

headlines.title: The new Amazon Fire TV Stick HD is on sale for $20
headlines.description: Amazon’s newest Fire TV Stick HD is on sale for $20, down from $35. Here’s what makes this upgraded, ultra-portable streaming device worth buying now.

headlines.title: Shoppers say this now-$40 Dutch oven delivers Le Creuset-quality results
headlines.description: This popular Dutch oven is similar to a Le Creuset, but it’s 50% off, bringing the price to $40. Shop this Deal of the Day while it lasts.

headlines.title: Macy’s Black Friday in July sale — Save up to 70% while you still can
headlines.description: During the Macy’s Black Friday in July sale you can save on skin care, apparel, fragrance, appliances and more.

headlines.title: How the cyclospora lettuce outbreak sparked a massive consumer trust crisis
headlines.description: The cyclospora outbreak has people avoiding salads and burrito bowls. Now, for many Americans the question is whether any lettuce can be trusted.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: U.S. measles cases reach 35-year high in 2026, surpassing last year’s total
headlines.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported Friday that the United States has logged 2,318 measles cases in the first seven months of this year, surpassing last year’s total of 2,289.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak expands to 9 states
headlines.description: The massive, multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis has expanded to nine states, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said Friday.
